title: Summer with Ensana in Marienbad
metaDescription: Join the Ensana summer competition: 10 fun questions about Marienbad and a prize draw for a stay for two at the Hvězda hotel.

intro.text: We've prepared a summer competition for you. Ten questions about Marienbad await — some test your memory, others your imagination. Everyone who reaches the end and leaves us their email enters the draw for a stay at the Ensana Hvězda hotel.
intro.prize: Grand prize: 2 nights for 2 — a Mini Spa Break (Minikúra) at the Ensana Hvězda hotel
intro.drawNote: The draw takes place on 1 September.

questions.text: How many mineral springs rise directly in Marienbad?
questions.explanation: Around 40 springs rise in the town itself, with roughly 100 more in the surroundings. One stay won't be enough to taste them all.

questions.text: Which crowned guest loved Marienbad so much that he still has his own spa cabin here?
questions.explanation: King Edward VII — you can still find his Royal Cabin at the Ensana Nové Lázně hotel.

questions.text: Which composer gives his name to the town's famous music festival?
questions.explanation: The Chopin Festival — Chopin, like Goethe, was one of the town's famous visitors.

questions.text: Marienbad has been UNESCO-listed since 2021. Under what title?
questions.explanation: Together with other renowned spas, Marienbad has been part of the UNESCO series “Great Spa Towns of Europe” since 2021.

questions.text: What does the famous fountain by the colonnade do that keeps drawing the crowds?

options.text: It changes colour with the weather
It fires a 30-metre jet every hour

questions.explanation: The Singing Fountain is one of the town's landmarks — its water display comes alive with music.

questions.text: Maria's Spring doesn't produce water, but something else. What?
questions.explanation: Maria's gas is 99.7% carbon dioxide of volcanic origin, used for gas injections and dry gas baths.

questions.text: What is the Ensana Hvězda hotel — home of our grand prize — famous for?
questions.explanation: The Hvězda pool world covers 2,100 m² — the largest in town. Plus a salt cave and Café Imperial.

questions.text: In which hotel can you bathe in the historic Roman Baths of 1896?
questions.explanation: The Roman Baths at the five-star Nové Lázně hotel have welcomed guests since 1896.

questions.text: How long is Marienbad's spa tradition?
questions.explanation: The spa tradition dates back to 1808. Since 2023, Marienbad has also been an official climatic spa.

questions.text: And finally, no tricks this time: what does your dream spa summer look like? Tell us in a few words.
questions.placeholder: E.g. a morning cup at the spring, afternoons by the pool…

results.title: Spa connoisseur!
results.message: Brilliant! You could be giving tours of the colonnade. Only one thing left — come and enjoy summer with Ensana in person.

results.title: Almost a local
results.message: Great effort! Marienbad still keeps a few secrets from you — best uncovered right at the springs.

results.title: One more reason to visit
results.message: No worries! All of this is best learnt right on the colonnade. And you're in the draw either way.

emailGate.heading: You made it — now into the draw!
emailGate.text: Leave us your name and email and you'll be entered into the draw for a stay at the Ensana Hvězda hotel: 2 nights for 2 with a Mini Spa Break. The winner will be drawn on 1 September and notified by email.
emailGate.consentLabel: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purposes of this competition and to receiving news from Marienbad by email. You can unsubscribe at any time.
emailGate.successText: Fingers crossed — the draw takes place on 1 September. Until then, see you at the springs.
